receipt.public_excerpt: After almost a decade, I have made the decision to leave OpenAI.

evidence_items.explanation: Sutskever presents the departure as his decision. This supports classifying it as voluntary on the public record.

evidence_items.locator: Departure announcement, sentence describing future plans

receipt.public_excerpt: My immediate plan is to work on my personal projects and see what happens.

evidence_items.explanation: His announcement describes leaving for personal projects and denies a precipitating dispute. It supports a voluntary classification.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph discussing high-profile departures; also opening paragraph and Kokotajlo paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt: Another senior safety researcher, Jan Leike, quit in May, saying that OpenAI’s safety culture had taken a “backseat” to releasing new products.

evidence_items.explanation: The report establishes Leike's resignation and also identifies Saunders's February resignation and Kokotajlo's April resignation. These add three voluntary departures to the roster.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph following the discussion of Saunders's role

receipt.public_excerpt: Two executives, Diane Yoon and Chris Clark, quit last week, The Information reported.

evidence_items.explanation: The report identifies Yoon as VP of people and Clark as head of nonprofit and strategic initiatives. Both are expressly described as quitting.

evidence_items.locator: First sentence of the note to colleagues

receipt.public_excerpt: I've made the difficult decision to leave OpenAI.

evidence_items.explanation: Schulman identifies himself as a founding team member and explains his choice to move to Anthropic. The announcement supports a voluntary classification.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning The dissolution of OpenAI's superalignment team

receipt.public_excerpt: Two researchers on the team, Leopold Aschenbrenner and Pavel Izmailov, were dismissed for leaking company secrets, The Information reported last month.

evidence_items.explanation: Count two firings, without endorsing the alleged grounds. The article also records policy research lead Cullen O'Keefe's April exit; its circumstances remain unclassified.

receipt.public_excerpt: The news of Brockman’s and Deng’s departures was earlier reported by The Information.

inputs: e1-e5: eight voluntary departures—Sutskever, Karpathy, Leike, Saunders, Kokotajlo, Yoon, Clark, Schulman
e6-e7: two departures of unknown type—O'Keefe and Deng
